directions.forward: sequence to function: a context-conditioned effect prediction. It needs a measured transfer for the stated genotype, species, cell state, stage and condition.
directions.inverse: function to sequence: propose a CANDIDATE SET, then reuse the forward checks on every member. An edge that is not a calibrated transfer for the context is never inverted, and a set is never one guaranteed genome.

must_not_say: a working genome or construct was designed
homology or a marker shows a function transfers to this organism
an unresolved interface is a violated constraint
a calibration measured in one context holds in another
rules: a sequence is accepted only as a pinned artifact whose bytes still match
a calibration applies only when every context field equals the design's
a measured bound must equal the bound in its pinned measurement
homology or marker similarity leaves an interface unknown
a claimed working assembly is rejected while any interface is not a calibrated transfer for its own context
a build plan stays a proposal
